```{=html}
                                      margin-top: 30px;
        }
        
        .standards-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
          gap: 20px;
          margin-top: 20px;
        }
        
        .standard-group {
          background: white;

          padding: 20px;
          border-left: 5px solid #1e3c72;
        }
        
        .standard-group-title {
          font-size: 1.1rem;

          color: #1e3c72;

        }

          display: flex;

        }
        
        .standard-item:last-child {
          border-bottom: none;
        }
        
        .standard-metal {
          font-weight: 600;

        .standard-value {
          font-weight: 700;

          text-transform: uppercase;

        .risk-safe { background: #d4edda; color: #155724; }
```

```         
                                                                                                                                                                                          'Mercury': [1.5, 1.2, 0.8, 1.8, 0.4],
                                                                                                                                                                                          'Cadmium': [3.2, 2.4, 1.6, 4.0, 0.8],
                                                                                                                                                                                          'Arsenic': [2.8, 2.1, 1.4, 3.5, 0.7],
                                                                                                                                                                                          'Copper': [0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 1.0, 0.2],

                                                                                                                                                                                  // Color scale for risk levels
                                                                                                                                                                                  const colorScale = d3.scaleThreshold()
                                                                                                                                                                                  .domain([1, 2, 10, 100])
                                                                                                                                                                                  .range(['#2d5aa0', '#65a642', '#ffa500', '#ff4444', '#8b0000']);
                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                  function getRiskColor(value) {
                                                                                                                                                                                    return colorScale(value);
                                                                                                                                                                                  }
                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                  function getRiskLevel(value) {
                                                                                                                                                                                    if (value <= 1) return 'Safe';
                                                                                                                                                                                    if (value <= 2) return 'Moderate';
                                                                                                                                                                                    if (value <= 10) return 'High';
                                                                                                                                                                                    if (value <= 100) return 'Critical';
                                                                                                                                                                                    return 'Extreme';
                                                                                                                                                                                  }
                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                  // Create tooltip
                                                                                                                                                                                  const tooltip = d3.select('body').append('div')
                                                                                                                                                                                  .attr('class', 'tooltip')
                                                                                                                                                                                  .style('opacity', 0);
                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                  function createHeatmap(containerId, data, title) {
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Clear existing content
                                                                                                                                                                                    d3.select(`#${containerId}`).selectAll("*").remove();
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    const margin = { top: 40, right: 40, bottom: 60, left: 120 };
                                                                                                                                                                                    const width = 500 - margin.left - margin.right;
                                                                                                                                                                                    const height = 360 - margin.bottom - margin.top;
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    const svg = d3.select(`#${containerId}`)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .append('svg')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('width', width + margin.left + margin.right)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('height', height + margin.top + margin.bottom);
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    const g = svg.append('g')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('transform', `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Prepare data for heatmap
                                                                                                                                                                                    const heatmapData = [];
                                                                                                                                                                                    const matrices = Object.keys(data);
                                                                                                                                                                                    const metals = Object.keys(data[matrices[0]]);
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    matrices.forEach((matrix, i) => {
                                                                                                                                                                                      metals.forEach((metal, j) => {
                                                                                                                                                                                        const values = data[matrix][metal];
                                                                                                                                                                                        const avgValue = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
                                                                                                                                                                                        heatmapData.push({
                                                                                                                                                                                          matrix: matrix,
                                                                                                                                                                                          metal: metal,
                                                                                                                                                                                          value: avgValue,
                                                                                                                                                                                          matrixIndex: i,
                                                                                                                                                                                          metalIndex: j,
                                                                                                                                                                                          allValues: values
                                                                                                                                                                                        });
                                                                                                                                                                                      });
                                                                                                                                                                                    });
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Scales
                                                                                                                                                                                    const xScale = d3.scaleBand()
                                                                                                                                                                                    .domain(metals)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .range([0, width])
                                                                                                                                                                                    .padding(0.05);
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    const yScale = d3.scaleBand()
                                                                                                                                                                                    .domain(matrices)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .range([0, height])
                                                                                                                                                                                    .padding(0.05);
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Create cells
                                                                                                                                                                                    g.selectAll('.cell')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .data(heatmapData)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .enter().append('rect')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('class', 'cell')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('x', d => xScale(d.metal))
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('y', d => yScale(d.matrix))
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('width', xScale.bandwidth())
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('height', yScale.bandwidth())
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('fill', d => getRiskColor(d.value))
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('stroke', '#fff')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('stroke-width', '2px')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .on('mouseover', function(event, d) {
                                                                                                                                                                                      tooltip.transition()
                                                                                                                                                                                      .duration(200)
                                                                                                                                                                                      .style('opacity', .9);
                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                      const riskLevel = getRiskLevel(d.value);
                                                                                                                                                                                      const riskClass = `risk-${riskLevel.toLowerCase()}`;
                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                      tooltip.html(`
                                                                                                                                                                                                   <strong>${d.matrix} - ${d.metal}</strong><br/>
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Average Exceedance: <strong>${d.value.toFixed(1)}x</strong><br/>
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Risk Level: <span class="risk-indicator ${riskClass}">${riskLevel}</span><br/>
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Range: ${Math.min(...d.allValues).toFixed(1)}x - ${Math.max(...d.allValues).toFixed(1)}x<br/>
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Sites: ${d.allValues.length}
                                                                                                                                                                                                   `)
                                                                                                                                                                                      .style('left', (event.pageX + 10) + 'px')
                                                                                                                                                                                      .style('top', (event.pageY - 28) + 'px');
                                                                                                                                                                                    })
                                                                                                                                                                                    .on('mouseout', function(d) {
                                                                                                                                                                                      tooltip.transition()
                                                                                                                                                                                      .duration(500)
                                                                                                                                                                                      .style('opacity', 0);
                                                                                                                                                                                    });
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Add text labels for high values
                                                                                                                                                                                    g.selectAll('.cell-text')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .data(heatmapData.filter(d => d.value >= 10))
                                                                                                                                                                                    .enter().append('text')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('class', 'cell-text')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('x', d => xScale(d.metal) + xScale.bandwidth() / 2)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('y', d => yScale(d.matrix) + yScale.bandwidth() / 2)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('dy', '.35em')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('text-anchor', 'middle')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('fill', d => d.value > 50 ? 'white' : 'black')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('font-size', '10px')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('font-weight', 'bold')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .text(d => d.value >= 1000 ? `${(d.value/1000).toFixed(0)}k` : `${d.value.toFixed(0)}x`);
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Add axes
                                                                                                                                                                                    g.append('g')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('transform', `translate(0, ${height})`)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .call(d3.axisBottom(xScale))
                                                                                                                                                                                    .selectAll('text')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('text-anchor', 'end')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('dx', '-.8em')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('dy', '.15em')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('transform', 'rotate(-45)');
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    g.append('g')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .call(d3.axisLeft(yScale));
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Add title
                                                                                                                                                                                    svg.append('text')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('x', (width + margin.left + margin.right) / 2)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('y', 20)
                                                                                                                                                                                    .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('font-size', '14px')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .style('font-weight', 'bold')
                                                                                                                                                                                    .text(title);
                                                                                                                                                                                  }
                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                  function updateHeatmaps(period) {
                                                                                                                                                                                    const data = studyData[period];
                                                                                                                                                                                    if (!data) return;
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    createHeatmap('contamination-heatmap', data.data, `${data.title} - Contamination Levels`);
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    // Create standards comparison heatmap
                                                                                                                                                                                    const standardsData = {};
                                                                                                                                                                                    Object.keys(data.data).forEach(matrix => {
                                                                                                                                                                                      standardsData[matrix] = {};
                                                                                                                                                                                      Object.keys(data.data[matrix]).forEach(metal => {
                                                                                                                                                                                        // Calculate compliance percentage
                                                                                                                                                                                        const values = data.data[matrix][metal];
                                                                                                                                                                                        const compliantSites = values.filter(v => v <= 1).length;
                                                                                                                                                                                        const complianceRate = (compliantSites / values.length) * 100;
                                                                                                                                                                                        standardsData[matrix][metal] = [100 - complianceRate]; // Convert to exceedance rate
                                                                                                                                                                                      });
                                                                                                                                                                                    });
                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                    createHeatmap('standards-heatmap', standardsData, `${data.title} - Standards Exceedance %`);
                                                                                                                                                                                  }
                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                  // Initialize with 2024 data
                                                                                                                                                                                  updateHeatmaps('2024');
                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                  // Add event listeners for period buttons
                                                                                                                                                                                  document.querySelectorAll('.period-btn').forEach(btn => {
                                                                                                                                                                                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                                                                                                                                                                                      document.querySelectorAll('.period-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                                                                                                                                                                                      this.classList.add('active');
                                                                                                                                                                                      updateHeatmaps(this.dataset.period);
                                                                                                                                                                                    });
                                                                                                                                                                                  });
                                                                                                                                                                                  </script>
                                                                                                                                                                                    </body>
                                                                                                                                                                                    </html>
```
